reviews.review:
Unironically has so much potential to be a hit horror game in the streaming community!

1) On the first night shift, honestly man just take the chase sequence out. Its such an overdone slop trope that quickly pulled me AND my community out of. It makes zero sense to be there. You guys clearly know how to make a cooking sim, do the same but with body parts. Thats not anything that has been done before and the horror switchup could seriously be something so cool and fun as well as creative.

2) Stealth scenes are honestly just boring and annoying at this point. Theres enough story in what you have so far that you dont need added bloat. Have the player search the underground areas and put the pieces together to figure out whats going on and why and then call it a day.

3) The audio balance for jumpscares is INSANELY off. No one wants their ears to be blown out

A horror sushi sim is honestly the best play here, please dont devalue a potentially amazing game by splattering it with the stereotypical horror loud sounds and chase scenes. Keep it simple and people will love it.
